# Palm Beach Recovery Center

> > Comprehensive addiction treatment and mental health services in West Palm Beach, Florida, offering medical detox, residential programs, and trauma-informed care for substance use disorders.

Palm Beach Recovery Center (PBRC) provides evidence-based addiction treatment throughout South Florida, including specialized programs for alcoholism, opioid addiction, and co-occurring mental health disorders. Led by clinical experts including Kristin Miller LCSW and Braulio Mariano-Mejia MD, the center serves communities across Palm Beach County and surrounding areas with medication-assisted treatment, family therapy, and holistic recovery approaches.

## Key Topics

- Medical Detox Programs
- Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)
- Trauma-Informed Care
- Co-Occurring Disorders
- Residential Inpatient Treatment
- Alcohol Detoxification
- Opioid Addiction Treatment
- Family Therapy
- Withdrawal Management
- West Palm Beach Services
- South Florida Recovery
- 12-Step Programs (AA/NA)
- Behavioral Therapy
- Aftercare & Sober Living
- Veterans Treatment Programs

## Core Treatment Programs

- [About Us - Palm Beach Recovery Center](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/about-us): Mission, team profiles, and clinical services for co-occurring diagnoses
- [Detox Program West Palm Beach](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/detox-program-west-palm-beach): Comprehensive detox program for alcohol, cocaine, heroin, and prescriptions
- [Alcohol Detoxification](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/treatment-services/detox/aclohol): Medical alcohol detox and residential treatment in West Palm Beach
- [Medication-Assisted Treatment for Alcoholism West Palm Beach](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/medication-assisted-treatment-for-alcoholism-west-palm-beach): MAT program for alcoholism in West Palm Beach with craving management
- [Alcohol Addiction Counseling West Palm Beach](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/alcohol-addiction-counseling-west-palm-beach): Alcohol addiction counseling with behavioral therapy in West Palm Beach
- [Family Therapy West Palm Beach](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/family-therapy-west-palm-beach): Family therapy services in West Palm Beach for addiction recovery support

## Regional Services

- [Addiction Treatment in Indian River County](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/indian-river-county): Addiction treatment services for Indian River County, Florida residents

- [Things to Keep in Mind When Choosing a Detox Center](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/10-things-to-keep-in-mind-while-choosing-a-detox-center): Guide listing 10 factors for selecting quality detox center treatment

- [Benefits of Living in a Sober Home After Rehab](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/benefits-of-living-in-a-sober-home-after-rehab): Explains sober living benefits for post-rehab recovery and aftercare
- [What's the Difference Between AA and NA?](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/difference-between-aa-and-na): Compares Alcoholics Anonymous and Narcotics Anonymous 12-step programs
- [What to Do If My Loved One Won't Go to Rehab?](https://palmbeachrecoverycenters.com/what-to-do-if-my-loved-one-wont-go-to-rehab): Guidance for families on intervention and supporting resistant loved ones
